intent: Use only persisted official Pokémon TCG assets from the repository; construct the night-arena context with CSS rather than a generated full-frame background.

assets.reason: Pikachu, Mew, and Mewtwo already share perspective and illumination in one official composition, removing the isolated-character failure.
Adds real competitors, Pokémon venue graphics, and a verifiable tournament context inside an in-world broadcast ribbon.
Preserves Pokémon TCG identity rather than leaving the scene as generic esports.
Makes the host's deck-building subject physically present in the foreground.
Connects the ensemble backdrop to an authentic collectible instead of a detached mascot sticker.

nonAssetLayers: broadcast score bar and live state
forbidden: mixing unrelated daylight cast shadows into foreground assets
